title: Palindrome Permutation II
description: Given a string s, return all the palindromic permutations (without duplicates) of it.
pseudocode:
1. Count frequencies of each character.
2. Identify characters with odd counts.
3. If more than one character has an odd count, return empty list.
4. Build half of the palindrome using available characters.
5. Use backtracking to generate all permutations of the half.
6. Concatenate half + mid + reverse(half) to form palindromes.
